verdict.rationale: Zulip's own docs describe a bot framework for interactive bots that react to messages, which can be deployed to production via the Zulip Botserver, so bots clearly receive incoming messages. The pack never documents a real-time events API, event queue or gateway connection, or event types beyond messages. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a real-time events API or long-poll/streaming mechanism, coverage of non-message events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a bot that receives messages and events in real time through an events API or gateway connection

citations.quote: Zulip’s API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
Eventually, you’ll probably want to run it in a production environment where it’ll stay up, by deploying it on a server using the Zulip Botserver.
